baseline: p2-additive (freeze_id POWE-3-D6-ITER-CHAMPION-1); scorer d88f2a4b; datus b38e71c3

scoring.comparator: Decimal absolute 5e-7, no relative tolerance, dict members included
scoring.s_agent: online model tool call attempts (failures/retries counted)

question_sets.s2r10: old-R slice covering C4 template families (single-hop T05 + double-hop T02/T06/T07/T08): qids 1,15,21,25,27,29,31,33,35,37
question_sets.h2: H2-23 v2.1 EXPOSED regression only (never blind)

selection_rule_finalists: D23x3 mean C desc -> mean J desc -> mean S_agent asc; finalists = arms beating their screening anchor on C, or stage-line passing S3 variants

screening_rules.s2: same-content consumption comparison on s2r10 x1: p2 anchor (frozen runner) vs s2render vs s2direct (r3 runner); report C/J/meanS + per-family; benefit hypothesis = fewer errors/requests, J unchanged
screening_rules.s3: content increment on d10 x1: p2 anchor vs p2+exp-v1 vs p2+exp-v2; increment = C improvement with J not collapsing

better_result_rule_push_branch: push swift/powe-152-r3 (no PR, no merge) iff the round champion achieves H2x3 gate-13 correct strictly > 25/39 (p2 frozen 64.1%) while old-R x3 mean J >= 14/23 and D23x3 mean C >= p2 D23x3 mean C - 1; otherwise no push
freeze_discipline: champion frozen (digests + timestamp) AFTER D23x3 selection and BEFORE any R/H2 run; lineage.jsonl records every prep/exec/score
h3_boundary: H3/D3 (POWE-153) never read until the coordinator freezes and releases; no round-3 arm derives content from H2 traces
infra_policy: assembly-phase failures (connector/DNS before question_injected, steps=None) are re-run up to 3 attempts, each logged; model-phase failures stay as unknown in denominators; DB host pinned to resolved IP due to resolver NXDOMAIN flaps (hostname+IP logged per plan)
